meta.seo_title: Real Estate Meta Ads Case Study | PPC Guru
meta.meta_description: How PPC Guru launched Meta Ads for a Canadian real estate agent, delivering 8 Instant-Form leads at about CA$19 each plus 8 WhatsApp chats in month one.

headline: A Real Estate Agent's First Month on Meta Ads: 8 Leads + 8 WhatsApp Chats
summary_line: PPC Guru launched Meta advertising for a Canadian real estate agent in July 2026. In its first month the account produced 8 Instant-Form leads at about CA$19.33 each and opened 8 WhatsApp conversations, giving the agent 16 genuine buyer and seller enquiries to follow up. This is an early launch snapshot based on a single month of data.
client_context: Sold by Kaushik is a Canadian real estate professional who helps buyers and sellers through the property process. For an individual agent, a dependable flow of enquiries — people ready to talk about buying or selling — is the engine of the business. Meta (Facebook and Instagram) lets an agent reach local prospects and open a direct conversation, whether through a lead form or a WhatsApp chat, at the moment they are considering a move.
background: The agent partnered with PPC Guru to build a measurable lead source on Meta rather than relying on referrals and organic reach alone. PPC Guru launched the account in July 2026 with two complementary campaigns: a native Instant-Form campaign to capture contact details, and a WhatsApp messaging campaign to start direct conversations with interested prospects.
analysis: Because this is a fresh launch, the priority was to stand up clean lead capture and measurement from day one and to test two ways of reaching prospects side by side — a form for people who prefer to leave details, and WhatsApp for people who prefer to chat. The first month establishes a baseline cost per enquiry that PPC Guru will optimise against as more data accumulates.
analysis_points: Launch a native Instant-Form campaign to capture buyer and seller contact details on-platform.
Run a parallel WhatsApp messaging campaign to open direct conversations with prospects.
Measure cost per form lead and cost per conversation from the first day.
Use month-one results as the baseline for ongoing optimisation.

timeline.what: PPC Guru launched two Meta campaigns — Instant Form and WhatsApp — producing 8 form leads and 8 WhatsApp conversations in the first month.
Gather more data across a full quarter to confirm cost per enquiry and scale the better-performing objective.

challenge: As a new launch, the account had no Meta history to build on — no proven audiences, creative or cost benchmarks. The task was to establish reliable lead capture across two objectives and produce genuine enquiries the agent could act on, while keeping a clean read on what each enquiry costs.

changes.why: Captures a name and contact details on-platform so the agent can follow up quickly with interested buyers and sellers.
Opens a direct chat with prospects who prefer to message rather than fill in a form.
Tests which route produces better enquiries for the cost before concentrating budget.
Tracks cost per form lead and cost per conversation from launch, not clicks or reach.

technical.label: Form campaign
technical.value: PPC - Sold by kaushik - Instant Form

benchmark: These figures cover a single launch month (July 2026), so they are an early snapshot rather than a trend. Cost per enquiry should be read as a starting baseline that PPC Guru will work to improve as the account gathers more data.
lessons: Give prospects two ways to reach you — a form for details and WhatsApp for a quick chat.
Capture contact details on-platform so no enquiry slips away to a slow landing page.
Measure cost per genuine enquiry from day one, not clicks or reach.
Treat the first month as a baseline and optimise from real data rather than assumptions.
Follow up with new leads fast — speed to contact matters in real estate.
why_it_worked: Two lead objectives launched together gave the agent both form leads and live conversations.
On-platform capture kept enquiries fast and frictionless for a mobile audience.
Clean measurement from day one set an honest cost-per-enquiry baseline.
The form campaign delivered leads at about $19.33 each in its first month.
outcome: In its first month on Meta with PPC Guru (July 2026), Sold by Kaushik generated 16 genuine enquiries — 8 Instant-Form leads at about $19.33 each and 8 WhatsApp conversations. As a launch snapshot from a single month, these results are an encouraging start rather than a settled trend. PPC Guru will confirm cost per enquiry over a fuller window and scale the objective that proves most efficient.
cta: PPC Guru helps Canadian real estate agents turn Facebook and Instagram into a steady, measurable source of buyer and seller enquiries.
methodology: All figures are pulled directly from the client's Meta Ads account for July 2026, the account's first and only month of delivery to date. 'Leads' are genuine Instant-Form submissions; WhatsApp conversations are reported separately as messaging conversations. Because only one month of data exists, this is a launch snapshot and is marked for review as more data accumulates.
teaser: 📈 Real estate Meta Ads launch: PPC Guru's first month for Sold by Kaushik delivered 8 Instant-Form leads at ~$19.33 each plus 8 WhatsApp chats — 16 genuine enquiries in month one.
